items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: But Jesse was in Chicago and then, I knew a lot of other people.

ctx.x: He was a fine arranger, wasn't he?
And piano player. He was a good arranger, yeah. But Jesse was in Chicago and then, I knew a lot of other people. I knew a guy named Eddie Torrenti who was an old friend of
mine and then he was a friend of Valetta's. And then I met Jimmie Noone and then I met Earl Hines, Barney Bigard, Omer Simeon...Who was playing the drums for Earl Hines then? He lived in...ah....
